create_shift_bijector: create a Shift bijector with a numeric shift parameter for elementwise translation
forward_shift_transform: compute the forward transform y = x + shift using the Shift bijector
inverse_shift_transform: compute the inverse transform x = y - shift using the Shift bijector
forward_and_log_det_jacobian: compute the forward transform and its log determinant Jacobian together
compare_shift_bijectors: compare two Shift bijectors for equality using the same_as method
